name: job-helper
description: AI-powered job search assistant for Indian professionals: parallel scouts browse LinkedIn, Naukri, Indeed, and YC Work at a Startup in your own Chrome session, plus direct web-fetch scouts for Wellfound and freshly funded Indian startups, keep only fresh low-competition postings, find recruiter/founder contacts and draft a personalized connection note + direct message per contact, draft referral requests, generate a tailored cover letter for top matches only, remember your profile permanently, and track applications.
